Folder mode (Syncthing)

Mirror saves and states to a folder that Syncthing syncs, instead of RomM. Valkyr makes no network connection itself; Syncthing moves the folder. Changed saves are backed up first, conflicts wait for your choice and nothing is deleted. Tip: add .dogmatix-* to the folder\'s .stignore so Valkyr\'s temporary files are not synced.
Syncthing folder
Pick the folder Syncthing syncs. Saves go in saves/, states in states/. The saves and states folders above are used for this device.
Switch on folder mode and pick the folder first.

BIOS files belong in the bios folder next to roms (the SHARE partition), not inside roms. After copying, run START > Game Settings > Update Gamelists. Valkyr writes no game lists.
BIOS files belong in /userdata/bios, next to the roms folder. Valkyr writes no game lists.
After copying, run START > Game Settings > Tools > Update Gamelists. Valkyr writes no game lists. BIOS locations are on the system pages of rocknix.org.
BIOS files belong in MUOS/bios on the storage that holds the MUOS folder. Valkyr writes no list, name or artwork files; add them with muOS\'s own tools.
